summary: Iteration 5, frontend only. Desktop 1920x1080 and iPhone 390x844, Playwright with checks against localStorage. Every requested flow passed and there were no console or page errors. (1) Compare: preset-open-test-pnr-over → open-defense-btn → defense-compare-btn opens compare-dialog with two canvases side by side (677x759 each). Defaults are man:switch and man:over. compare-play animates both panes in sync (both went Fase 1→2→3→4 at the same moment). At Fase 3, pane A shows 'Cambio: D5 prende la palla, D1 anticipa il rollante' and pane B shows 'D1 passa sopra e insegue, D5 contiene...'. With select B set to zone23, pane B shows zone notes. After closing, play.phases positions and play.defense are identical to before. (2) Selective: defense-strategy-selective opens selective-options with switch-tol-0/1 and mismatch-over/under/contain/show/help all visible. With default sizes, Fase 3 reads 'D5 (lungo) e D1 (esterno) troppo diversi → passaggio sopra il blocco'. Tapping d5 on canvas → player-size-F stores size 'F' and the panel text updates to 'D5 ala'. After regenerating, Fase 3 reads 'hanno taglie compatibili → cambio' and 'D5 sulla palla tra A1 e canestro' (d5 1.43m from o1, d1 3.69m). switch-tol-0 + mismatch-under gives 'troppo diversi → passaggio sotto il blocco'. The generate-overwrite-btn confirm never appeared for this preset. (3) Zone roles zone23: setting zone-role-c to d1 moves d5 to gL (swap), and the reading lists 'D5: prima linea sinistra ... D1: centro'. zone32: setting t to d5 moves d1 to lR, and the reading gives 'Sulla palla: D5 (punta)'. Custom roles are kept per mode when switching back. (4) Live ON in Fase 2: changing zone-role-c to d1 instantly swaps the d1 and d5 positions; d2, d3 and d4 stay unchanged. (5) Regression: timeline playback animates, a live drag of o1 makes all defenders react, and undo restores o1. On mobile 390x844 the compare panes stack vertically (A at y=192, B at y=505), and play and selects are tappable.

issues: compare-select-a and compare-select-b are only 112px wide, so labels are cut to 'Uomo · Can' / 'Uomo · Pass' and you can't tell the strategies apart without opening the select. Consider putting the selects on their own row (w-full) on narrow screens, or using shorter labels.
The court canvases are only about 200px tall on mobile. This is usable but small.
The description says 'a sinistra e a destra', but on portrait the panes are stacked top and bottom.

Pane notes are cut to 5 entries (notes.slice(0,5)) in a 92px box. In zone mode the role list loses D4/D5, and in man mode with selective the 'Spinta' line can be dropped. Consider removing the slice, since the box already scrolls.

action_items: LOW: On mobile, make the compare selects full width or shorten their labels so the strategy names are readable
LOW: Remove notes.slice(0,5) in CompareDialog Pane (the box already scrolls)
LOW (copy): Make the CompareDialog description neutral about pane orientation
critical_code_review_comments: In DefensePanel, zoneRoleMap(play, cfg.mode, cfg) is recomputed inside ROLE_ORDER.map for every role. Compute it once before the map. This is trivial perf and clarity.
In CompareDialog Pane, setPhase is called from draw() inside requestAnimationFrame. This is fine, but each pane re-renders on every phase change. That is acceptable.
Zone-role changes with live OFF do not reposition defenders until 'Genera difesa' is pressed. This is consistent with man-mode behaviour, but a hint in the UI could help.
seed_data_creation: Library preset copies only, in ephemeral browser localStorage
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigate directly to /libreria, then preset-open-test-pnr-over. This creates a copy (ids o1..o5, d1..d5; 4 phases). Clicking phase chips while the defense Sheet is open closes the sheet, so select the phase first. Read notes from the defense-reading element or from __play().phases[i].defInfo. Inject /app/tests/helpers.js for __sp/__play/__hash. Zone role selects use defender ids (d1..d5) as values.
